title: Promotion Decisions and the Adoption of Explicit Potential Assessment
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: one firm switched its performance-management system to include an explicit potential assessment at one point in time, so POSTPERIOD x PROMOTED (ia_ppprom) is a common-date DiD-style interaction. The replicable models are pooled OLS of next-year performance rating on ia_ppprom with rating, age, log tenure, gender, year dummies (2010-2014), rank and service-line dummies (time-varying controls, no employee FE). Fails the staggered-adoption rule.
design_notes: Employee-year data from a single professional-services firm (confidential). The package replicates only Column (2) of Table 3 (reg f1_rating ia_ppprom rating age log_jobtenure gender prom pyear_* rank* sl_*) and Table 7 (promoted x rating/potential interactions) on synthetic data drawn with corr2data from the original means, SDs and correlation matrices (n = 4,429 and 1,212).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: No staggered binary adoption in the reported designs.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; pooled OLS without unit FE; time-varying controls
specs.time_var: year dummies pyear_2010 pyear_2011 pyear_2013 pyear_2014

data_files_note: No microdata: the code generates synthetic datasets with corr2data from moments of the original data (NDA with the research firm; agreement with the DE).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README PDF). Single-firm, single-date system change.
